name: APPEAL_GRV_LATE_FILE_RSNS
description: Stores the reasons for late filing for an appeal/grievance.

columns.name: APPEAL_GRV_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the appeal/grievance record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: LATE_FILING_RSN_C_NAME
columns.description: The reason category ID for the appeal/grievance. This describes why the appeal/grievance was filed late.
entries: Did Not Receive Timely Notice Of Adverse Determination
Provided Insufficient Information About Appeals Process
Sent Request on Time to Incorrect Address
